'''Dune Street''' was a street in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. The [[Methane Fix Cantina/Legends|Methane Fix Cantina]] and the wreckage of the [[Dowager Queen/Legends|''Dowager Queen'']] were located on this street.

[[File:Mos_Eisley_spaceship.png|thumb|left|250px|The ''Dowager Queen'' at Dune Street in Mos Eisley.]]
It was on this road where [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] were stopped by an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] checkpoint while they were traveling through the city.
